title: Crimsonite
description: Adds Crimsonite Ore to the world — a rare mineral found in deepslate layers. Mine it to collect Crimsonite Shards, which can be smelted into gold ingots.
body:
# Crimsonite

Crimsonite adds a new rare ore to Minecraft's deepslate layers, giving miners a new material to discover and smelt.

## Features

- **Crimsonite Ore** - Spawns in deepslate layers. Requires a stone pickaxe or better to mine.
- **Crimsonite Shard** - Dropped when you mine Crimsonite Ore. Can be smelted into a gold ingot.

## Crafting and Smelting

Mine Crimsonite Ore to collect Crimsonite Shards, then smelt them in a furnace to produce gold ingots.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.x
